## Add my site to the showcase

**Site:** <!-- the address -->

**About it:** <!-- a sentence or two -->

- [ ] The site is live and public, and it uses Pagefold
- [ ] I built it, or I have permission to show it, and the people who designed and built it are credited
- [ ] It is well made and accessible: usable with the keyboard, readable contrast, sensible headings
- [ ] The cover is a screenshot of the home page, 1600 x 1000 px, under 400 KB (see the [guide](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#showcase))
- [ ] The folder is `showcase/my-site-name` with an `index.md` and the cover next to it
- [ ] `pnpm check:showcase` passes
